# ebaycli monorepo

This repository contains:

- `/cli`: the eBay CLI package
- `/backend`: the ASP.NET reference backend relay

Use these entrypoints:

- CLI docs: `/cli/README.md`
- CLI package and source: `/cli/package.json`, `/cli/src`
- Architecture: `/docs/agent-first-architecture.md`
- Backend docs: `/backend/EbayStoreManager.Api/README.md`
- Backend solution: `/backend/EbayStoreManager.sln`

The public product story is CLI first with backend-relayed OAuth for production. The backend owns eBay app credentials for a deployment; the CLI stores the local seller session and performs listing workflows.
